row.team_price_text: Starter: from $14.99/month (3 users included; price scales with shipment volume)
row.evidence: ShipStation's pricing comparison lists only Google SSO for login, and its help centre says the available SSO provider is Gmail ('More coming soon!'); no SCIM or SAML is documented on the pricing page, help centre or API docs.
row.notes: New row. No SCIM and no SAML/OIDC SSO with a customer IdP: the only 'SSO' is linking a personal Google (Gmail) login. Pricing is flat per plan and scales by monthly shipment volume (Starter $14.99, Standard $29.99, Premium $349.99 /month at 50 shipments), with 3/10/15 users included and extra users at a per-user monthly fee; the page has a Monthly/Annual toggle (annual '20% SAVINGS') and the static page shows these prices without saying which billing they reflect. Users are added and deactivated manually in Settings > User Management. API V1 ('API access' on Standard and Premium, not Starter) only exposes a read-only GET /users list. Okta's catalogue app is password vaulting (SWA) only.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Comparison table: API access not included (icon), Google SSO included; Google sign-in is not SAML.

scim.notes: No SCIM found: help-centre search for 'scim' and 'okta' returns 0 articles; pricing, API V1 and API V2 docs do not mention it.

auth.notes: API Key as username and API Secret as password.

capabilities.notes: The only documented user endpoint is List Users (read-only).

limitations.text: API V1 has no endpoints to create, update or deactivate users; user management is UI-only.

okta.notes: OIN page (last updated Aug. 5 2021) marks only SWA as supported; SAML, SCIM and provisioning are unchecked.
